import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, f, c, d;

        public Edge(int a, int b, int f, int c, int d) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.d = d;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Graph {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        List<Edge> ed;

        public Graph(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                this.adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            this.ed = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        public void addEdge(int a, int b, int c, int d) {
            Edge e = new Edge(a, b, 0, c, d);
            this.adj.get(a).add(this.ed.size());
            this.ed.add(e);

            Edge e1 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0, -d);
            this.adj.get(b).add(this.ed.size());
            this.ed.add(e1);
        }

        public Pair spfa(int n) {
            int[] dis = new int[n + 1];
            boolean[] inq = new boolean[n + 1];
            int[] mnf = new int[n + 1];
            int[] pth = new int[n + 1];

            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                dis[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }

            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(0);
            dis[0] = 0;
            inq[0] = true;
            mnf[0] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = false;
                for (int id : this.adj.get(u)) {
                    int v = this.ed.get(id).b;
                    if (this.ed.get(id).c > this.ed.get(id).f && dis[v] > dis[u] + this.ed.get(id).d) {
                        dis[v] = dis[u] + this.ed.get(id).d;
                        pth[v] = id;
                        mnf[v] = Math.min(mnf[u], this.ed.get(id).c - this.ed.get(id).f);
                        if (!inq[v]) {
                            q.add(v);
                            inq[v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dis[n] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                return new Pair(0, 0);
            }

            int v = n;
            while (v != 0) {
                int id = pth[v];
                this.ed.get(id).f += mnf[n];
                this.ed.get(id ^ 1).f -= mnf[n];
                v = this.ed.get(id).a;
            }

            return new Pair(mnf[n], dis[n] * mnf[n]);
        }

        public Pair mcmf(int n) {
            int flow = 0;
            int cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Pair p = this.spfa(n);
                if (p.first == 0) {
                    return new Pair(flow, cost);
                }
                flow += p.first;
                cost += p.second;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Graph g = new Graph(100 * n + 100 + 2);
        int[] fr = new int[n + 1];
        List<List<Integer>> gr = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            gr.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            fr[x]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            gr.get(u).add(v);
            gr.get(v).add(u);
        }

        int sr = 0;
        int sn = 100 * n + n + 1;
        for (int tm = 0; tm <= 99; tm++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                g.addEdge(n * tm + i, n * (tm + 1) + i, k, 0);
                for (int x : gr.get(i)) {
                    for (int cp = 1; cp <= k; cp++) {
                        g.addEdge(n * tm + i, n * (tm + 1) + x, 1, d * (2 * cp - 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (fr[i] > 0) {
                g.addEdge(sr, i, fr[i], 0);
            }
        }

        for (int tm = 0; tm <= 100; tm++) {
            g.addEdge(n * tm + 1, sn, k, c * tm);
        }

        pw.println(g.mcmf(sn).second);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void addEdge(Graph g, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        Edge e = new Edge(a, b, 0, c, d);
        g.adj.get(a).add(g.ed.size());
        g.ed.add(e);

        Edge e1 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0, -d);
        g.adj.get(b).add(g.ed.size());
        g.ed.add(e1);
    }
